evidence: The as-grown MoS2 thin film on sapphire does not show any excitonic features in the optical absorption. This could be due to the poor crystallinity of the as-grown film at 300 /C14 C. After annealing between 700 and 800 /C14 C, excitonic peaks A ( /C24 1.85 eV) and B ( /C24 2.00 eV) appear. 34,35 This suggests that high temperature annealing is able to reconstruct the as-grown film and improves its crystallinity.
